correctness.rationale: The prior Boolean blow-up structural theorem gives m=2^r-2 independent classes T_S of size w_S=∏_(i∈S)λ_i with disjointness adjacency for all nonempty proper S; λ_i>=2 guarantees a blue representative after at-most-one-white restriction. Two white false twins form a permanent fort. For any nonempty white-type set, choose inclusion-minimal white T; its complement T^c is adjacent to precisely white types U⊆T, of which T is the only one, hence can force T. This proves the complete product u^(N-m)∏_(S)(u+w_S), all minimum sets and Z=N-m. Quotient disjointness adjacency has determinant -1: embed in full Kronecker power [[1,1],[1,0]]^(⊗r), determinant 1 for r>=2 and delete ∅, [r] border to obtain -det(A). Blowing up yields real rank m, matching M<=Z. Multiset of polynomial roots gives all nonempty proper subset products; adding unit 1 and recovered total product, greedy multiset factor peeling recovers all λ_i including repeats. Independent exact small-r determinant and graph/forcing checks corroborate; infinite arbitrary-r proof is symbolic.
